translations.web: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
translations.bsb: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?
translations.kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
translations.asv: thou who gloriest in the law, through thy transgression of the law dishonorest thou God?
